# TPC-DI VQ12

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcdi
```

> [TPC-DI](../../tpc-di.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DI queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT 'Cash Balance Consistency Validation' AS validation_name, cb.SK_CustomerID, cb.SK_AccountID, cb.Cash AS current_cash_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN tt.TT_IS_SELL IS TRUE THEN ft.Quantity * ft.TradePrice - ft.Fee - ft.Commission - ft.Tax WHEN tt.TT_IS_SELL IS FALSE THEN -(ft.Quantity * ft.TradePrice + ft.Fee + ft.Commission + ft.Tax) ELSE 0 END) AS calculated_cash_impact, ABS(cb.Cash - SUM(CASE WHEN tt.TT_IS_SELL IS TRUE THEN ft.Quantity * ft.TradePrice - ft.Fee - ft.Commission - ft.Tax WHEN tt.TT_IS_SELL IS FALSE THEN -(ft.Quantity * ft.TradePrice + ft.Fee + ft.Commission + ft.Tax) ELSE 0 END)) AS balance_discrepancy, CASE WHEN ABS(cb.Cash - SUM(CASE WHEN tt.TT_IS_SELL IS TRUE THEN ft.Quantity * ft.TradePrice - ft.Fee - ft.Commission - ft.Tax WHEN tt.TT_IS_SELL IS FALSE THEN -(ft.Quantity * ft.TradePrice + ft.Fee + ft.Commission + ft.Tax) ELSE 0 END)) <= 1000.0 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status FROM FactCashBalances AS cb LEFT JOIN FactTrade AS ft ON cb.SK_CustomerID = ft.SK_CustomerID AND cb.SK_AccountID = ft.SK_AccountID LEFT JOIN TradeType AS tt ON ft.Type = tt.TT_ID WHERE ft.Status = 'Completed' GROUP BY cb.SK_CustomerID, cb.SK_AccountID, cb.Cash HAVING COUNT(ft.TradeID) > 0 ORDER BY balance_discrepancy DESC LIMIT 100
```
